title: Person
description: A person: the name they are filed under, the other names, their sex and what happened to them. Parents, families and children are derived from the families that list them.

living.description: Overrules the rule that presumes who is living: false for somebody dead with no record of it, true for somebody alive whom the rule would not believe.

name.description: The name the person is filed under, by convention the name at birth.

also-known-as.description: Every other name, each in the same shape as name.

sex.description: What the sources say, M, F or X, or a mapping of it with sources; left out where they do not say, and U is read as that.

portrait.description: Which attached image is a picture of this person, or a file with the region that is this one.

sources.description: What the record rests on as a whole, where no one fact does.
